name: Holiday name
aboutInfo: This adapter is free and open source. If you find it useful, please consider supporting its development with a small donation.
descNext: The next holiday still ahead — a holiday that falls today stays in the today channel.
descDayName: Empty on a day that is not a holiday.
descDayIsHoliday: Also true for bridge days while bridge days are switched on.
descNextName: Empty while no upcoming holiday was found.
descNextIsHoliday: False when no upcoming holiday was found at all.
descNextDate: Always ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), independent of the date format set in ioBroker.
descNextDaysUntil: 0 means no upcoming holiday was found — a real one is always at least one day ahead.
